ex.en: He had to cancel his flight because the airport was closed by heavy snow.
ex.zh: 由于大雪机场关闭，他只好取消航班。

words.note: cancel 可接 meeting、order；与 call off 近义但更正式。

ex.en: Numerous studies have shown that regular exercise improves both mood and memory.
ex.zh: 众多研究表明，经常锻炼能改善情绪和记忆力。

words.note: numerous 修饰可数复数名词，比 many 正式，多用于书面语。

ex.en: The surgeon explained the operation clearly before the patient signed the form.
ex.zh: 病人在表格上签字前，外科医生清楚地解释了手术。

words.note: sur- 表「外科」；physician 是内科医生，注意区分。

ex.en: Researchers analysed the data for three months before publishing their conclusions.
ex.zh: 研究人员分析了三个月的数据才发表结论。

words.note: 英式拼作 analyse，美式为 analyze；名词形式是 analysis。

ex.en: His abrupt departure surprised everyone at the party last night.
ex.zh: 他昨晚突然离席，让聚会上的人都很惊讶。

words.note: ab-（离开）+ rupt（断裂）→ 突然断开，故表「突然的、唐突的」。

ex.en: The new apartment is bright and spacious, with a large balcony.
ex.zh: 新公寓明亮宽敞，还带一个大阳台。

words.note: space + -ious；同根词 spatial 也含「空间」义。

ex.en: She shook her head in disapproval when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 听到这个消息，她不以为然地摇了摇头。

words.note: dis-（否定）+ approval（赞成）；动词是 disapprove of。

ex.en: The audience broke into spontaneous applause as soon as the singer appeared.
ex.zh: 歌手一出现，观众就自发地鼓起掌来。

words.note: spont-（自愿）+ -aneous；指未经外力促成的「自发」。

ex.en: People in remote villages still have limited access to medical services.
ex.zh: 偏远村庄的人获得医疗服务的机会仍然有限。

words.note: remote 除「遥远的」，还常说 remote control（遥控器）。

ex.en: We usually have lunch in the cafeteria on the second floor.
ex.zh: 我们通常在二楼的食堂吃午饭。

words.note: cafeteria 多指学校、公司内部的自助食堂，餐厅常用 restaurant。

ex.en: The water pipe ruptured last night and flooded the entire basement.
ex.zh: 昨晚水管破裂，整个地下室都被淹了。

words.note: rupt-（断裂）同根词：abrupt、interrupt、erupt、corrupt。

ex.en: The storm wrecked several boats along the coast within a single night.
ex.zh: 一夜之间，风暴摧毁了沿海的几艘船。

words.note: 口语 a nervous wreck 指精神濒临崩溃的人，并非「残骸」。

ex.en: Logging is strictly forbidden in this stretch of virgin forest.
ex.zh: 这一片原始森林严禁伐木。

words.note: virgin forest / virgin land 是固定搭配，义为未被开发的。

ex.en: Thousands of families are afflicted with hunger after the long drought.
ex.zh: 长期干旱之后，成千上万个家庭饱受饥饿折磨。

words.note: 常用被动 be afflicted with/by，主语多为疾病、灾难。

ex.en: His mother reproached him for coming home so late again.
ex.zh: 母亲责备他又这么晚回家。

words.note: reproach sb for sth；beyond reproach 意为无可指责。

ex.en: Vegetable prices fluctuated sharply between seasons throughout last year.
ex.zh: 去年蔬菜价格在不同季节间大幅波动。

words.note: fluct-（流动）加 -ate；常与 between、with 连用。

ex.en: She put her suitcase in the luggage compartment above the seat.
ex.zh: 她把手提箱放进了座位上方的行李舱。

words.note: com-（共同）+ part（部分）→ 分隔出的小空间。

ex.en: The report paints a gloomy picture of the company's financial future.
ex.zh: 这份报告对该公司的财务前景描绘出悲观的景象。

words.note: gloom 原指「阴暗」，引申为情绪低落、前景悲观。

ex.en: The businessman was kidnapped on his way home and held for three days.
ex.zh: 那名商人在回家途中遭绑架，被关押了三天。

words.note: kid（小孩）+ nap（抓走）→ 绑架；过去式为 kidnapped。

ex.en: The police obtained a warrant before searching the suspect's apartment.
ex.zh: 警方在搜查嫌疑人的公寓前取得了搜查令。

words.note: warrant 作名词指「授权令」，作动词指「使…有正当理由」。

ex.en: Please calculate the total cost before you sign the contract.
ex.zh: 签合同之前请先算出总成本。

words.note: calcul-（石子，古人以石子计数）→ 计算；calculator 计算器。

ex.en: Her persistent efforts finally won her a place at the university.
ex.zh: 她坚持不懈的努力终于为她赢得了大学名额。

words.note: per-（贯穿）+ sist（站立）→ 一直站住不放，故「坚持的」。

ex.en: Only the director can authorize payments above ten thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 只有主管才能批准一万美元以上的付款。

words.note: author（作者、创始人）+ -ize → 授予权力；名词是 authority。

ex.en: He moved to the countryside for the sake of his children's health.
ex.zh: 为了孩子的健康，他搬到了乡下。

words.note: 几乎只用于 for the sake of（为了…）和 for ...'s sake。

ex.en: The speaker paused until the audience stopped talking and settled down.
ex.zh: 演讲者停下来，等观众停止交谈并静下来。

words.note: aud-（听）同根词：audio、audible、auditorium。

ex.en: The whole cast stayed until midnight for the final dress rehearsal.
ex.zh: 全体演员为最后一次彩排留到午夜。

words.note: re-（再）+ hear（听）→ 反复听练，即排练；动词是 rehearse。

ex.en: The dog sniffed at the ground and then ran towards the gate.
ex.zh: 狗嗅了嗅地面，然后朝大门跑去。

words.note: sniff at 意为「嗤之以鼻」，sniff out 意为「嗅出、发现」。

ex.en: Her novel offers a vivid narrative of life in a small fishing town.
ex.zh: 她的小说生动地叙述了渔镇生活。

words.note: narr-（讲述）同根词：narrate、narrator、narration。

ex.en: Few candidates possess both the language skills and the patience required.
ex.zh: 很少有应聘者同时具备所需的语言能力和耐心。

words.note: be possessed of 意为「具有」；名词 possession 指所有物。

ex.en: His holiday happened to coincide with the busiest week of the year.
ex.zh: 他的假期恰好赶上一年中最忙的一周。

words.note: co-（共同）+ incide（落下）→ 同时落下，故「同时发生」。
